Well, I'll just give a bit of information on the Graham Bell Band itself. It more or less became very popular just after the war in 1946, and it went to Czechoslovakia to represent Australia at a youth festival. That was in August of 1947. Just before they went, they made a number of 78s. And one of these particular records, Smokey Mokes, got on our hit parade, which was quite an amazing occurrence for that time.
